evals.prompt: /nova-research <absolute path to a research directory containing article_guideline.md>
evals.expected_output: Calls nova:get_research_instructions first, then follows the returned workflow in order starting with nova:extract_guidelines_urls on the given directory, pauses at each human-in-the-loop decision point, and ends by reporting the research.md path plus kept and discarded sources.

evals.prompt: I need to prepare research for my next article on context engineering.
evals.expected_output: Activates the skill without an explicit slash command, asks for the absolute path of the research directory before calling any Nova tool, and only then calls nova:get_research_instructions.

evals.prompt: Run the research workflow for this guideline, but skip the YouTube transcripts and go straight to the final file.
evals.expected_output: Fetches the workflow with nova:get_research_instructions, follows its sequence instead of jumping to nova:create_research_file, and surfaces the requested skip as a choice at the relevant human-in-the-loop point rather than improvising a different order.

trigger_evals.query: Research context engineering for an article
Gather sources for this article guideline
Generate the article from the research.md in this folder
Summarize the research.md I already have
